This regression may indicate a significant issue with the visibility of critical UI elements.
The improvement in 'NML510 - Trial Balance Report' from 44% to 10% suggests positive changes.
Four tests remained stable, indicating some areas are functioning as expected.
The observed pattern in 'RSS310Q - Attachments' could reflect a timing issue or recent code changes.

Further investigation into the locator failures may clarify the underlying issues.
Comparing test results across environments could help isolate the cause of the regression.
